answer: Pay only for forecasts that survive the future: each identity stakes on one verifiable prediction about the next epoch, drawn from a nebula of upcoming events, and a raven courier delivers the resolved outcome that no one can alter after the fact. Correct forecasters share one fixed pool of nectar, so ten clones copying the same forecast split the same pool ten ways while each pays a full stake, and clones guessing differently lose their stakes on wrong calls. One honest agent with one good forecast keeps its share; a farm gains nothing by multiplying accounts.
